पूज् {c10c} U. (पूजयति-ते,
पूजयांचकारचक्रे, अपूपुजत्-त, अपुपूजत्-त, पूजयितुं,
पूजित)
1 To adore, worship, revere,
honour, receive with respect;
यदपूपुजस्त्वमिह पार्थ मुरजितमपूजितं सतां
Śi. 15. 14;

पूजक a. (जिका f.) [पूज्-ण्वुल्]
Honouring, adoring, worshipping,
respecting &c.

.
--2 Treating with respect,
entertaining, hospitality.
--3 An object of
reverence.
--नी A hen-sparrow.

पूजा [पूज्-भावे-अ] Worship,
honour, adoration, respect, homage;

.
--Comp.
--अर्ह a.
venerable, respectable, worshipful,
worthy of reverence.

पूजित p. p. [पूज्-क्त]
1 Honoured,
respected.
--2 Adored, revered.
--3
Acknowledged.
--4 Endowed.
--5
Recommended.
--6 Frequented.

पूजिल a. Venerable, respectable.
--लः A god.

पूज्य a. Deserving respect,
worthy of honour, respectable,
venerable.
--ज्यः A father-in-law.
